intro: With Vione on Paros and Canaves Ena on Santorini, here is everything in between, arranged through Original Senses, my partner in Athens. A deposit locks it all in; the balance is due a month before you land.

transfers.title: All four island transfers
transfers.note: Paros airport to Vione, Vione to Paros port, Santorini port to Canaves Ena, and Canaves Ena to Santorini airport. Luxury vehicle with an English-speaking driver.

ferries.title: Paros to Santorini, Champions League Jet 2

boats.title: Private full day to Antiparos, Despotiko & Panteronissia
boats.note: Seven hours on a Fost 28 RIB with your own captain. Drinks, light snacks and fruit, snorkel masks and towels, hotel transfers both ways.

boats.title: Private sunset caldera cruise
boats.note: Five hours on a Lagoon 450 catamaran, BBQ cooked on board, wine, beer and soft drinks, snorkel gear, hotel transfers both ways.

optional.title: Half day instead, on a Nordkapp 27 cruiser
optional.note: Same islands in four hours. Replaces the full day.

optional.title: Semi-private sunset cruise instead
optional.note: The same Lagoon 450 shared with a small group, shared transfers. Replaces the private cruise.

optional_note: Not in the total above. Either one swaps out the private version; tell me before you pay and I will adjust the deposit.
